name: NOPE (Negative Object Presence Evaluation)
description: NOPE is a benchmark designed to measure object hallucination in vision-language models by evaluating their ability to correctly identify the non-existence of objects in visual question answering tasks using 29.5k synthetic negative pronoun data.
reputation: A well-known hallucination-focused VLM benchmark that is commonly referenced in object presence and negative-answer evaluation studies.
notes: Uses LLMs to generate synthetic negative pronoun data; reveals all tested VL models perform poorly on object hallucination detection.
